mapper.sql: recruitment.id, recruitment.account_id, recruitment.company_id, recruitment.support_program_id, recruitment.title, recruitment.body, recruitment.own_role, recruitment.seeking_role, recruitment.seeking_count, recruitment.region, recruitment.minimum_company_age_years, recruitment.capabilities, recruitment.recruitment_deadline, recruitment.closed_at, recruitment.created_at, recruitment.updated_at, company.company_name, company.region AS company_region, company.industry AS company_industry, company.founded_year AS company_founded_year, account.email_verified_at AS account_email_verified_at, program.source_code AS program_source_code, program.source_program_id AS program_source_program_id, program.title AS program_title, program.organization AS program_organization, program.summary AS program_summary, program.target_description AS program_target_description, program.application_period_raw AS program_application_period_raw, program.application_start_date AS program_application_start_date, program.application_end_date AS program_application_end_date, program.source_url AS program_source_url

FROM partner_recruitment recruitment JOIN company ON company.id = recruitment.company_id JOIN account ON account.id = recruitment.account_id JOIN support_program program ON program.id = recruitment.support_program_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url FROM support_program WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId} AND is_source_present = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner_recruitment ( account_id, company_id, support_program_id, title, body, own_role, seeking_role, seeking_count, region, minimum_company_age_years, capabilities, recruitment_deadline, closed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{companyId}, #{supportProgramId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{ownRole}, #{seekingRole}, #{seekingCount}, #{region}, #{minimumCompanyAgeYears}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{recruitmentDeadline}, #{closedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_recruitment SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, own_role = #{ownRole}, seeking_role = #{seekingRole}, seeking_count = #{seekingCount}, region = #{region}, minimum_company_age_years = #{minimumCompanyAgeYears}, capabilities = #{capabilitiesJson}, recruitment_deadline = #{recruitmentDeadline}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND closed_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY recruitment.created_at DESC, recruitment.id DESC
ORDER BY recruitment.recruitment_deadline ASC, recruitment.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partner_recruitment recruitment WHERE recruitment.account_id = #{accountId} AND recruitment.closed_at IS NULL
